reason: A local knowledge-management plugin that indexes uploaded documents and session summaries, then provides bounded hybrid vector and lexical retrieval through an explicit search tool.

summaries.zh: 一个本地知识管理插件，可索引上传文档和会话摘要，并通过显式搜索工具提供受限的向量与词法混合检索。
summaries.en: A local knowledge-management plugin that indexes uploaded documents and session summaries and provides bounded hybrid vector and lexical retrieval through an explicit search tool.

capabilities: Ingests and parses locally uploaded documents
Stores local document indexes and session compaction summaries
Provides model-directed local retrieval through a search tool
Downloads and manages local embedding model artifacts
Supports editing, logical deletion, and revision rollback of indexed content
